projects.name: FieldPulse
projects.title: FieldPulse — Distributed Industrial IoT Backend
projects.summary: A distributed Industrial IoT backend for device management, MQTT telemetry ingestion, alerting, and observability. Built with Go and gRPC, using TimescaleDB for time-series data, PostgreSQL for device records, and Redis for transient state.

projects.name: AgentCart
projects.title: AgentCart — Autonomous Shopping Agent
projects.summary: A prototype shopping agent that compares offers and explores a payment flow with signed spending limits. Connects natural-language intent, merchant discovery, and checkout in one project.

projects.name: ros2-jazzy
projects.title: ros2-jazzy — Edge Telemetry Ingestion
projects.summary: A reproducible ROS 2 Jazzy pipeline that sends simulated GPS, odometry, and diagnostic telemetry through MQTT into SQLite, then exposes recent records through a read-only FastAPI service. Includes an optional recorded-camera to LiveKit WebRTC workflow.

projects.name: PhotoStack
projects.title: PhotoStack — Self-Hosted Photo Library
projects.summary: A self-hosted photo library that organizes images by timeline, album, and GPS metadata, with duplicate detection. Built with a FastAPI backend, SQLAlchemy, and a TypeScript frontend.
